==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My VR superhero sandbox game is more than just a game. Beings from other realities are drawn to it. They've started appearing inside of the game world.

I am tasked by one of these beings to go save another that is lost somewhere within the world. The being tasking me has become my mentor in how to better use my abilities. I definitely need the assistance, as I have very little experience playing the game at all.

The game is single player, but other players with otherworldly mentors have begun spawning inside of my version of the game. Another player is behind the disappearance of the being that I'm looking for. My memory is hazy and I don't recall if I actually got to fight this other player before my alarm went off.
